title: airgap-dd: simulated replay channel for speech deepfake detection on edge voice devices
description: Code and result files for the study "Can a Simulated Replay Channel Replace Real Replay Data? A Controlled Study of Speech Deepfake Detection for Edge Voice Devices". Contains the four-stage replay channel simulator (loudspeaker response, nonlinear distortion, room impulse response, codec), feature extraction, detectors, evaluation code, a personalised liveness detector for a Raspberry Pi, and the scripts and result files for the liveness experiments. No audio is included.
